summary: Install and configure the Infinity data source with basic auth and a private connection, then build a dashboard from CSV data.

needs.description: Publicly reachable CSV endpoint; guide uses https://thingspeak.com/channels/38629/feed.csv.
Private Data Source Connect network and a running PDC agent selectable in the 'Private data source connect' field.
needs.evidence: Before you begin: Created a private connection and PDC agent is running (recommended, not required)

reviewNotes: PDC step selects an existing PDC network; if none exists the step may fail. Guide creates an Infinity datasource (and a dashboard variable infinitySource) itself.
